claim_boundary: Conditional plate candidate from frozen FreeCAD SVG; manual group/view/family/projection, no general drawing claim.

normalization.circle_policy: four quarter cubic approximation checked against controls; exact CAD radius comes from diameter label
normalization.coordinate_system: sheet millimetres; model coordinates from displayed dimensions
normalization.duplicates: coincident outlines/circles deduplicated; filled silhouettes require stroked counterparts
normalization.text_policy: XML characters with transformed baseline; no OCR or font glyph bounding-box recovery
